title: 3D Print Job Success Rate by Printer
dataSources: Print jobs (`octoprint:job`), printer firmware telemetry (`printer:telemetry`), filament spools (`filament:spool`), CNC/laser jobs (`cnc:job`), workshop air (`workshop:air`), cordless tool batteries (`tool:battery`).
app: OctoPrint / Klipper (Moonraker) print servers, printer firmware telemetry, filament spool tracking, CNC/laser job logs, and workshop air/tool sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=octoprint:job
| stats sum(eval(if(result="success",1,0))) as ok, count as jobs by printer
| eval success_pct=round(100*ok/jobs,1)
| sort success_pct
description: Calculates the success rate of each 3D printer so you can tell which machine is reliable and which needs attention.
value: A printer's success rate is the truest measure of its health; comparing machines shows where a tune-up or upgrade pays off.
implementation: Ingest print-job outcomes from OctoPrint/Moonraker; schedule weekly and rank printers by success rate.
visualization: Bar chart of print success rate by printer.
grandmaExplanation: It works out how often each 3D printer finishes a print successfully, so you know which one to trust.
